Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Filter assays by chembl_id CHEMBL1865 and activities by standard_type IC50. Filter docs by pubmed_id IS NOT NULL via LEFT JOIN docs on assays.doc_id. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
